mission_summary: PD27 (1715 H1 burn-in 0m alpha) + PD24 (NEW Vol/Skew alpha) + PD28 (synthetic ETF) 3-package inherit. z_composite = z_1715 × 0.818 + z_NEW × 0.182. Top20 select per sig_date. 3 weighting (A=EW 1/20, B=Alpha-tilt Linear, C=Softmax z-tilted with τ=median(|z|)). 4-sleeve composite (55% KR equity + 22.5% TSMOM + 18% KR_10Y + 4.5% Cash). 297m max backtest (2001-07~2026-04). vs S4 v2 baseline (SR 1.81 / CAGR 19.99% / MDD -12.63% / CVaR -5.01%) 4-axis strict.

alpha_composite.weights_rationale: PD27 1715 H1 sleeve weight = 0.818 (Sharpe-optimal blend per PD15 / PD20c, locked-in by Q-Lead mandate). NEW Vol/Skew sleeve weight = 0.182 (residual).
alpha_composite.fallback: t < 2001-07 → z_NEW solo (rare given window start). Missing ticker in either source → use available alpha only.
alpha_composite.normalization: per sig_date z-score (scale=1 sd, mean=0) for both z_1715 (from PD27 score_eff re-scaled) and z_NEW (from PD24 alpha re-scaled). Ensures 0.818/0.182 blend in comparable z-space.

A_EW.formula: w_i = 1/20 = 0.05 sleeve-internal → portfolio weight = 0.55 × 0.05 = 0.0275 (2.75%) per stock

B_LIN.formula: z_i^pos = max(z_composite_i, 0); w_i = z_i^pos / Σ z_j^pos sleeve-internal; portfolio = 0.55 × w_i
B_LIN.fallback_all_negative: If all z_composite negative → fallback to EW (1/20)
B_LIN.single_asset_cap_enforce: sleeve-internal cap = 0.20/0.55 = 0.3636 (after cap, redistribute excess to uncapped). Final portfolio weight max = 0.20.
B_LIN.rationale: score-proportional weighting consistent with 1715 H1 sleeve internal (PD27)

C_SOFT.formula: w_i = exp(z_composite_i / τ) / Σ exp(z_composite_j / τ); τ = median(|z_composite|) per sig_date
C_SOFT.tau_design: auto-tuned median absolute z to balance winner-take-all (low τ) vs ~EW (high τ). Median is robust to z outliers.
C_SOFT.rationale: smooth flattened tilting, robust to z noise

transaction_cost.embed_pattern: PD25 standard: total_turnover × 0.0015 deducted from gross_return per month

kr_inner_turnover_assumption.rationale: EW baseline 30% (PD25). LIN concentrates → higher effective turnover (45% assumed). SOFT mid-flatten (38%).

design.method: Method A canonical (PD26 verdict, first-trading-day anchor 미사용)

pure_function_audit_plan: Start hashes (alpha_h1_pd27, alpha_pd24, etf_pd28) recorded. End hashes compared. All match → audit PASS.

comparison_axes.improve_criteria: 4-axis strict (SR↑ + CAGR↑ + MDD better + CVaR better)
comparison_axes.hurdle_v22: TO 600% hard fail + MDD 45% hard fail + Grade A criteria (CAGR≥16% + SR≥0.8 + score≥40)
